objective: Maximize net total return among predefined unlevered long-only candidates; report drawdown, exposure and benchmark excess separately.

execution.exit: next open for indicator exit; gap-aware intraday initial stop; stop takes precedence
execution.allocation: equal fixed initial capital sleeves, one position per asset, no cross-sleeve borrowing
execution.cedearCash: ARS, NAV deflated by a GGAL CCL daily-close proxy

selection: Choose highest train net portfolio return with >=30 closed trades; use validation as a pass/fail gate; never retune using final holdout.
validationGate: Positive validation return and positive stress-cost return; compare winner with equal-asset buy-and-hold. Final holdout must be reported even if negative.
limitations: Fixed surviving-asset universe selected before outcomes; no claim of historical full-universe optimality.
Adjusted daily OHLC approximates corporate-action and dividend total returns.
CCL is a cross-quote proxy, not executable FX quotes. CEDEAR cash remains ARS.
Fees are conservative research assumptions, not a statement of actual broker commissions.
No shorts, leverage, funding, borrowing, tax or automatic execution.

amendments.reason: Before evaluating strategy returns: add four-hour crypto comparison to avoid limiting the search to daily models; record unusable META local history and corporate-action quality checks.

Before strategy outcomes: Yahoo local adjusted histories contain uncorrected certificate-ratio discontinuities. Use official BYMA execution bars, which expose only two years, and US-underlying indicators with causal next-local-open execution.
amendments.cedearSignalSource: US-underlying daily adjusted OHLC, warmed using longer history
amendments.cedearExecutionSource: Official BYMA daily OHLC; price-only results excluding unverified local dividend cashflows
amendments.activationRequires: No unexplained local ratio/split discontinuities in execution period; explicitly validate dividend sensitivity before claiming best total return.

amendments.reason: Before final test: clarify momentum lookback is bars (180 H4 bars = 30 days), not calendar days. Correct primary selection to include the benchmark, as the objective is net profit rather than activity. No trading parameters changed; preserve first development report.
amendments.primarySelection: Highest train net return among buy-and-hold and active candidates with >=30 natural exits. Negative-training active models are comparison controls, not deployment recommendations.
amendments.activeEconomicGate: Positive base and stressed validation/final returns with sufficient exits; combined validation+final net return must exceed buy-and-hold to support an active-profitability advantage.

amendments.reason: Before final test, fix the initial local-certificate stop conversion to use the known entry fill and the preceding US ATR as a percentage. This removes a first-session missing-local-quote artifact. Add raw-data hash verification and per-asset contributions; unchanged candidate parameters.
amendments.record: Previous development reports remain archived; final test has not been opened.

benchmarkPolicy: Buy-and-hold remains in rankings and can be the highest-return result; active strategies require sufficient closed trades before activation.
